title: Bacillus subtilis DnaB forms multiple protein-protein interactions essential for DNA replication initiation.
authors: Guyet, Aurelie; Campoy, Reyes Ruiz; Manja, Petra; Schramm, Frederic D; Pelliciari, Simone; Fenyk, Stepan; Li, Yuanyuan; Winterhalter, Charles; Ilangovan, Aravindan; Murray, Heath
one_liner_zh: 该文研究枯草芽孢杆菌DnaB在DNA复制起始中的蛋白-蛋白互作，虽涉及DNA复制起始和AlphaFold3结构预测，但核心是蛋白-蛋白而非TF-DNA转录因子结合，方法上仅部分使用AI结构预测，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联有限。
abstract: DNA replication is initiated at specific chromosomal loci termed origins. In bacteria, the master replication initiation protein DnaA unwinds the origin (oriC), allowing a pair of replicative helicases to be loaded around each strand of the DNA duplex. The molecular mechanisms for managing bacterial helicase loading at oriC are unclear. Here we have investigated the role of the essential accessory helicase loader DnaB in Bacillus subtilis. By identifying and characterizing DnaB residues that are critical for its role during DNA replication initiation, we have located three necessary protein-protein interactions that DnaB makes with initiation proteins DnaA, DnaD, and DnaI. Combining single particle cryo-electron microscopy, AlphaFold3 predictions, and two-hybrid interaction analyses, the data suggests that DnaB acts as an interaction hub to orchestrate dual helicase loading at the origin. We propose a model for DNA replication initiation in B. subtilis and related Firmicutes pathogens that employ DnaB-type helicase loaders.
abstract_zh: DNA复制起始于被称为复制起点的特定染色体位点。在细菌中，主复制起始蛋白DnaA解开复制起点（oriC），使得一对复制解旋酶能够加载到DNA双链的每条链上。在oriC处管理细菌解旋酶加载的分子机制尚不清楚。在此，我们研究了必需辅助解旋酶加载蛋白DnaB在枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）中的作用。通过识别并表征对DnaB在DNA复制起始过程中功能至关重要的残基，我们定位了DnaB与起始蛋白DnaA、DnaD和DnaI之间三个必要的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。结合单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-electron microscopy）、AlphaFold3预测和双杂交相互作用分析，数据表明DnaB作为相互作用枢纽，协调在复制起点处的双解旋酶加载。我们提出了一个针对枯草芽孢杆菌及采用DnaB型解旋酶加载蛋白的相关厚壁菌门（Firmicutes）病原体的DNA复制起始模型。
